legal_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 + Amendment Rules 2022

rules.name: Product Name / Generic Name Declaration
rules.message_on_fail: Product name or generic name is missing. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a).

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name and Address
rules.message_on_fail: Manufacturer, packer, or importer name and address is missing. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(c).

rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.message_on_fail: Net quantity is missing. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(b).

rules.name: MRP Declaration (inclusive of all taxes)
rules.message_on_fail: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is missing or improperly formatted. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(e). Must be inclusive of all taxes.

rules.name: Date of Manufacture / Packing / Best Before
rules.message_on_fail: Month and year of manufacture/packing is missing. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(d).

rules.name: Consumer Care Contact Details
rules.message_on_fail: Consumer care contact details (phone/email) are missing. Required under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(f).

rules.name: Net Quantity Unit Format (SI Units)
rules.message_on_fail: Net quantity unit does not follow standard SI notation. Use g, kg, ml, L etc.

rules.name: Country of Origin (Imported Products Only)
rules.message_on_fail: Country of origin is missing on an imported product. Mandatory under LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(g).
rules.message_not_applicable: Country of origin not required for domestic products.
